name: savepoint-diff
description: Shows live, unsaved changes in the editor gutter — like Git diff decorations, but without Git.
author: Ashish Sharma (Stay Elite)

commands.title: SavePoint Diff: Save All Unsaved Changes
SavePoint Diff: Create Savepoint (Don't Save to Disk)
SavePoint Diff: Cloud: Upload Project Folder...
SavePoint Diff: Cloud: View Savepoint History

savepointDiff.enabled.description: Enable or disable SavePoint Diff globally.

savepointDiff.showAdded.description: Show gutter markers for added lines.

savepointDiff.showModified.description: Show gutter markers for modified lines.

savepointDiff.showDeleted.description: Show gutter markers for deleted lines.

savepointDiff.showOverviewRuler.description: Show change markers in the overview ruler (the strip on the right of the editor).

savepointDiff.showBackgroundHighlight.description: Also lightly highlight the background of changed lines, in addition to gutter markers. Off by default so the extension never alters how your file visually reads unless you opt in.

savepointDiff.enableRevertInHover.description: Show a 'Revert this change' link when hovering a gutter marker, letting you discard a single added, modified, or deleted block back to its baseline content without saving. Also reachable from the Command Palette (SavePoint Diff: Revert Change), which acts on whatever change is under the cursor.

savepointDiff.maxFileSize.description: Maximum file size in bytes for which live diffing is computed. Larger files are skipped to protect performance. Must be a positive number; an invalid value (zero, negative, or non-numeric) falls back to the default.

savepointDiff.debounceMs.description: Milliseconds to wait after the last keystroke before recalculating the diff.

savepointDiff.snapshots.enabled.description: Enable Git/GitHub-style checkpoint snapshot history so you can view, compare, and revert to prior snapshots.

savepointDiff.snapshots.maxSnapshots.description: Maximum number of historical snapshots to retain per file.

savepointDiff.snapshots.autoSnapshotOnSa.description: Automatically capture a snapshot each time a file is saved.

savepointDiff.cloud.enabled.description: Optional: sync the project folder to cloud storage (via rclone) on save, as a private alternative to GitHub. Off by default; when off, no network is used.

savepointDiff.cloud.remote.description: rclone remote and folder to sync to, e.g. mydrive:projects/myapp. Set it with 'Cloud: Connect Storage'. Credentials live in your rclone config, never here.

savepointDiff.cloud.autoSyncOnSave.description: Sync changed files to the cloud automatically after each save.

savepointDiff.cloud.exclude.description: File or folder names never uploaded (supports * wildcards, matched per name).
